scope: Privacy-sanitized exact engine log excerpts for the three Qwen automatic-fit cells. Line numbers are one-based in each cell's exact promoted stderr file.

semantics: The automatic-fit layer count includes partial layers; n_part is the number of partial layers and those layers receive tensor-buffer overrides for overflow to another device or system memory.
The load_tensors offloaded-layer counter is printed from n_gpu_layers, whereas backend model-buffer sizes are printed separately.
Consequently, 49/49 is an engine layer-offload counter and does not by itself establish that every tensor or every model-buffer byte is physically resident in device memory.

interpretation_limits: The 49/49 counter must not be restated as proof of full device-memory residency.
CPU_Mapped and CUDA0 are separate engine-reported backend model-buffer sizes. This record does not infer physical resident-set memory, memory overlap, or an additive total from those values.

The three Qwen cells did not have matched fit outcomes: Q4_K_M reported 25 overflowing layers, IQ2_XXS reported 2, and IQ1_M reported no fit adjustment while retaining a 166.92 MiB CPU_Mapped model buffer.
